reason: Hypothesis A is more specific and physically sound: it pinpoints coherent FCC/BCC interphase boundaries as the site for dynamic precipitation, proposes a clear mechanism (stress-assisted diffusion and dislocation barrier), and includes a well-defined controlled comparison and falsification experiment.
